description: This file defines the 'WeightClass' controller class within the OpenCart Admin area for localisation. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and form handling for weight classes, including pagination, sorting, and editing functionalities.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing weight classes in the admin localisation section, including listing, editing, and saving weight class data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the weight class list page with pagination, sorting, and breadcrumb setup.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of weight classes with applied filters, sorting, and pagination, rendering the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the list of weight classes, including sorting links, pagination, and action buttons.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the add/edit form for a weight class, pre-filling data if editing an existing one.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a weight class, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected weight classes, with permission validation and JSON response.
